primary_secondary_endpoint: Table S27 source-published LFC A375 pDNA_D21 / LFC HepG2 pDNA_D21. 2026 outcomes inherited unchanged from C87.
primary_estimand: Equal-product/equal-cell weighted correlation of secondary2021 and newer2026 guide responses after separate product-by-cell centring.
uncertainty: 2000 dependence-cluster percentile bootstrap samples seed20261016, all guides and cells move jointly;95% interval. Dependence groups inherited C87.
permutation: 5000 within-product guide-identity permutations seed20261017, profiles move jointly across cells;two-sided add-one P.
